04 /

About & contact

I’m Dikshit. I like making complicated things easier to use.

I design for people across India with very different relationships with technology — from confident app users to people still finding their way with digital payments.

At BlackBuck, that means spending time on the ground with drivers and fleet owners: listening to their concerns, watching how they use their phones, and understanding what makes a payment feel trustworthy. Those conversations shape the flows I design, the language I use, and the decisions I make across apps, web and internal tools.
